goal: Authorize repository-local controlled publisher rollout and the one-time target-repository trust bootstrap barrier before autonomous ordinary source mutation in hwm-lab.

verified_facts.statement: P0A started from protected hwm-control/main 6abdbdac283b0849d3cd2429ab6985d9762c66c7, hwm-lab/main 74d27e855b9faba7c934d306af0be507f83ac5fe, and hwm_predictor/main 8fd669336b36064e842252d69fb4016cc526a9d4; completed Issue #72 was the only predecessor.

Protected hwm-control already contains reviewed hwm-publish-request/bootstrap-v1 and hwm-publish-result/bootstrap-v1 contracts, ADR 0001, controlled publisher implementation/security tests, and explicit exact-head ordinary CI dispatch; the runtime path is repository-bound and open+claimed/branch/path/CAS guarded, while serialization-point architecture ownership remains a governance requirement of the architecture/contract Issue.
Protected hwm-lab at 74d27e855b9faba7c934d306af0be507f83ac5fe contains repository bootstrap CI but no controlled task-branch publisher or equivalent exact-head publisher dispatch surface.

Duplicate search found no unfinished equivalent rollout authorization or hwm-lab installation barrier, so P0A Issue #78 and blocked P0B Issue #79 were created; Issue #73 was moved ready to blocked on completed #79 and remains unclaimed.

Controlled publisher request pub-i10-0078-claim-01 produced claim commit 8972325519e6578c6b209f9cd7736126e96306ea; its exact-head Infrastructure CI run 32053356795 failed only because the active-task Knowledge Delta was not yet present. Publisher run 32053324060 then failed posting its normalized result because GitHub API returned HTTP 503.

Controlled publisher request pub-i10-0078-claim-kd-01 added the required KD at commit 92f9ed31b7d21b200896b18a0db39eb5e146ac31, but a GitHub API HTTP 503 prevented exact-head CI association/result delivery; no alternate writer or manual CI dispatch was used.

Recovery request pub-i10-0078-claim-kd-recovery-01 completed through the controlled publisher with normalized success result, moving the task branch to c03678cc486c5a5a83c94a7ab21e5d82e2b11cae and dispatching Infrastructure CI run 32053820984 on that exact SHA; the CI run completed success.

decisions.decision: Keep bootstrap-v1 repository-local and require a separate architecture/contract installation barrier before hwm-lab or hwm-context ordinary autonomous source publication.
decisions.rationale: The installed hwm-control publisher is deliberately repository-bound and its ephemeral token must not be widened into a cross-repository writer.

decisions.decision: Authorize only a narrow one-time bootstrap transport for publisher self-installation in a target repository.
decisions.rationale: A target repository cannot use its controlled publisher before that reviewed transport exists locally; the exception therefore has an exact protected-main base, dedicated installation branch, narrow path allowlist, protected PR, CI/readback/merge checks, and mandatory live acceptance matrix.

decisions.decision: Preserve bootstrap-v1 schemas and publisher implementation unchanged in P0A; record rollout semantics only in authoritative INFRA_SPEC sections 10.1 and 10.2.
decisions.rationale: Merged bootstrap-v1 contracts/ADR/acceptance already define the primitive; P0A is the architecture authorization barrier, not a schema or implementation widening task.

decisions.decision: Do not compensate for publisher-side GitHub API transport failures with generic source writers or manual CI dispatch.
decisions.rationale: Exact-head publication and CI association must remain attributable to the reviewed controlled publisher path.

decisions.decision: After repository-local installation, recurring generic/manual source publication is a regression; I11 may version/extend the primitive but cannot replace it with unrestricted Git writing or arbitrary shell.
decisions.rationale: The durable trust boundary depends on typed, exact-head, path-limited publication rather than a generic writer.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use the ordinary hwm-control GITHUB_TOKEN as a cross-repository hwm-lab writer.
rejected_alternatives.reason: It is repository-scoped and cross-repository widening violates the selected least-privilege boundary.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Introduce a PAT, deploy key or GitHub App private key in P0A.
rejected_alternatives.reason: No separate security decision or demonstrated necessity authorizes that credential surface.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Install the hwm-lab publisher or begin Graphify implementation in P0A.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Installation is the blocked successor #79; Graphify implementation #73 remains blocked and unclaimed.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Widen bootstrap-v1 schemas or publisher policy while documenting rollout.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The requested barrier is a forward architecture amendment over already reviewed bootstrap-v1 semantics; contract widening is out of scope.

followups.task: I10-P1-P0B Issue #79 installs the same reviewed controlled publisher locally in hwm-lab and executes the required one-time bootstrap/live acceptance barrier.
